The quota rows close the case, they do not open it: first read the victim's endpoints or a connectivity probe on the victim's own Service. Scope the quota branch to the Service named by the complaint or the target of the failing call; missing Services that are not that victim are background. **No ResourceQuota object at all means the quota branch is excluded** — return to the symptom side and take the branch the healthy objects land on.
